findings.desc: CHK-003:edge:0 evidence command does not match the literal intent command. Intent specifies: grep -h "Final:" /tmp/b-2941-r{1,2,3}.log | grep -c "167/167" (expected output 3). Actual output of that command is 0 — the test:all runner emits no "Final:" prefix (confirmed: line format is bare "171/171 passed in N s") and count is 171 not 167. Evidence filed a substitute command grep -h "passed in" ... | grep -c "passed in" which does return 3 and the note honestly discloses the drift, but the literal command binding required by evidence-must-bind-literal-intent-command is not satisfied. The intent command itself is broken due to two simultaneous mismatches: (1) output format "Final:" prefix does not exist in actual runner output, (2) count 167/167 vs actual 171/171. The evidence note explains both, but that explanation does not substitute for running the literal intent command.

CHK-003:edge:0 evidence command substituted with one that does not verify the intended claim. The verificationIntent says grep -h "Final:" ... | grep -c "167/167" should output 3, but the recorded evidence instead runs grep -h "passed in" ... | grep -c "passed in" and gets 3. Actual check: grep -h "Final:" /tmp/b-2941-r{1,2,3}.log outputs 0 — no Final: prefix appears in any of the 3 real runs because retry never fired. The intent claim (all 3 runs end with Final 167/167) is not verified by the submitted evidence. The correct explanation is that when pass 1 is clean, no Final: is emitted (correct behavior), but the edge item was written assuming retry always fires. Either the edge intent should be reworded (covers retry-fires path via self-smoke case a/d) or a targeted test run that forces a timeout should be the evidence. Files: packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts:301 (closingLabel logic), packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts (cases a and d cover Final: semantics).
